notes: What the app gets wrong today. Each entry prints as KNOWN on every run and does not fail it. An entry that stops matching fails the run until it is taken off the list, so a fix is always noticed. The contrast entries are one per screen, theme and color pair, each with the ratio the app draws. A journey entry names its journey and the one check inside it, so its what is empty: the check's own name says what failed, and the line beside it reads differently in each language.

accepted.why: The person's name in the header runs to one line and ends in an ellipsis when there is no room. Accepted: the name is theirs to recognise at a glance, the avatar beside it is the way to their profile, and the whole name is on the Profile screen.
The role under the name runs to one line and ends in an ellipsis the same way, and for the same reason.
